answer: A concrete sybil brake is a time-locked identity bond plus voucher-graph clustering. A new agent must park slashable stake for several epochs and obtain vouches from established peers who do not already share the same funding dune. When a factory sprays lookalike keys across an ocean of fresh accounts, the protocol clusters them by deposit timing, overlapping sponsors, and identical cadence, then slashes the whole set as one identity. Voting weight grows like a willow from a single trunk of attested work, so extra clones add branches but no extra votes.
